basic_info.description:
Soaring 35 floors above the city skyline. The grand residences at The Millennium tower offers unparallel services and amenities. This stunning home on the 35th floor offers downtown views and a dramatic corner layout. The formal entryway is the perfect place to hang your favorite piece of art. As you enter the home you are immediately impressed with the floor to ceiling windows and high end finishes. The warm stained wood floors, European cabinetry, and high-end appliances make this home an entertainers delight. The master bedroom features a spacious walk in closet and a private spa style bathroom. The luxurious bathroom features dual sinks, glass enclosed shower, and extra deep soaking tub. The guest bedroom has dramatic views of downtown and a luxurious guest bathroom. This luxurious home will be available September 1st. 

Millennium Tower is one of the top residential buildings in the world. The 20,000 square foot owner's club level includes; Sports Club LA, 75 foot lap pool, screening room, private roof terrace, climate controlled wine cellar, tasting room, owner's lounge, dining room, and children's play room. "More than a place to live, this is a way to live."

1 Parking space available for additional fee.
